overview: Cost-effectiveness analysis alongside a concurrent comparison of the 2027 second-year tutorial groups, allocated by timetable block to four near-peer plus four faculty sessions or to eight faculty sessions.
population: All second-year students in 2027 (about 180 in 18 tutorial groups of 10); students with an agreed learning adjustment are included in their allocated group.
exposure: Near-peer arm: four sessions by final-year tutors who completed a one-hour calibration session and a teaching guide, plus four faculty sessions. Comparator: eight faculty sessions.
procedures: Timetable blocks alternate between arms, fixed before students are placed in groups. Station results come from the May 2027 OSCE, marked by examiners unaware of arm. Costs from finance records: sessional fees, tutor payments, training and supervision time, rooms and simulated patients.

outcomes.name: First-attempt pass on all examination-skills stations
outcomes.measure: Proportion of students passing all examination-skills stations at the first sitting
outcomes.why: The performance the school must protect; the effect measure for the ratio.

outcomes.name: Teaching cost per student
outcomes.measure: School-perspective cost of examination-skills teaching divided by students taught
outcomes.why: The other half of the ratio.

outcomes.name: Incremental cost per additional student passing
outcomes.measure: Difference in cost per student divided by difference in pass proportion, with a cost-effectiveness acceptability curve
outcomes.why: The decision measure the dean asked for.

outcomes.name: Session delivery and calibration
outcomes.measure: Sessions delivered as timetabled and tutors completing calibration
outcomes.why: Separates a failed format from failed delivery.

outcomes.name: Tutor time before finals
outcomes.measure: Hours tutors report spending on teaching in the eight weeks before their finals
outcomes.why: Guards against harm to tutors' own preparation.

feasibility: Uses scheduled teaching, existing examinations and finance records; about 4 hours per week of staff time for data and analysis.
biasMitigation: Allocation by timetable block fixed before group placement
Costs taken from finance records, not estimates
Tutor time valued in sensitivity analysis

biasFlags.label: Contamination between arms
biasFlags.note: Students may attend the other arm's sessions informally; attendance registers are checked.

biasFlags.label: Imprecision with one year
biasFlags.note: One class cannot estimate a small difference in pass rates; results are presented as probabilities of cost-effectiveness.

flags: First-year assessment score is the only adjustment variable
parsimony.simplestPath: One allocation by timetable, one effect measure, one cost measure, one ratio.

theoreticalFramework: None beyond standard economic evaluation methods (CHEERS reporting).
summary: Concurrent comparison of 18 tutorial groups with one primary effect measure and cost outcomes.
